text:
Anna and her husband Peter were very poor. Christmas was coming, but they had no money for gifts.

Anna had long, beautiful hair. It was her greatest treasure. Peter had a silver watch from his grandfather. He loved it very much.

Anna wanted to buy a chain for Peter’s watch. So she went to a shop and sold her hair. With the money, she bought a beautiful chain.

At the same time, Peter wanted to buy combs for Anna’s long hair. So he sold his watch. With the money, he bought a set of lovely combs.

That evening, they met at home. Anna gave Peter the chain. “But I sold my watch,” said Peter, and he gave her the combs. “And I sold my hair,” said Anna.

They looked at each other. For a moment, they were silent. Then they began to laugh and hugged each other.

“Our gifts are useless now,” said Peter. “But we have each other. That is the best gift of all.”

Moral: Love is the greatest gift.

quiz.q: Anna sold her hair to buy a chain.
What did Peter buy for Anna?
What did Peter and Anna do when they saw the gifts?
